integrity: Analytic proof based on a quartic block polynomial and finite-difference valuation estimates; integer computation provides only supplementary checks. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only exact 2-adic and 3-adic valuations for fourth powers are proved; primes >= 5, complete gcds, and other recurrences remain open. Literature searches cannot rule out unindexed or unpublished stronger results.
title: Exact two- and three-primary fourth-power sliding GCDs for the Pell companion pair
